title: Kernel coverage matrix and prefill/decoder shadow benchmarking
creator: Marisol Chen
description:
Problem: Recent kernel routing changes and a planned prefill/decoder scheduler tweak have unclear end-to-end impact across our model catalog and hardware matrix. Existing golden baselines and microbench harnesses focus on isolated kernels or synthetic traffic mixes, but we lack a consolidated kernel coverage matrix and a deterministic way to shadow-run prefill vs decode schedule changes against golden baselines in CI without flakiness.

Goal: Build a kernel coverage matrix that maps model families, sequence-length bands, and attention optimizations to the exact kernels exercised, then expand the benchmark harness to run ‘shadow’ prefill/decode schedule experiments that produce reproducible deltas against golden baselines. Tie the results into CI perf gates with clear pass/fail rules and triage playbooks.

Why this matters: Without these artifacts we have blind spots where kernel routing changes or scheduler improvements regress p95 latency or memory use on real workloads. By making the coverage explicit and the shadow runs deterministic we can push kernel and scheduler changes faster while keeping production SLOs safe.
acceptance_criteria: A kernel coverage matrix spreadsheet exists for top 12 models and maps sequence bands to primary kernels
Benchmark harness extension can run deterministic shadow prefill/decode experiments and emit tokenized delta reports
CI job is configured to run a lightweight smoke shadow run on PRs and a daily full deterministic run that compares against stored golden baselines
Perf gate rules documented: p50 <= 3% regression, p95 <= 5% regression, peak GPU memory regression <= 6%
Runbook added: steps to triage a perf regression including how to collect KR traces, perf.flame, and revert policies

progress_updates: 2026-02-18: Kickoff sync — agreed on top-12 model list and sequence bands. Action: Marisol to publish inventory by 2026-02-20.
2026-02-23: Kernel tracer prototype completed; tracer now annotates kernel execution with model_tag and seq_band. Microbench shows <2% overhead.
2026-03-02: Implemented shadow-mode in harness: can execute decode-only runs against live artifacts and collect KV-cache metrics. Still flaky at p95 on H100-80GB when batch sizes <2.
2026-03-06: Noise reduction tasks: added fixed RNG seed, deterministic batching order, and preallocated KV-cache state. p95 variance dropped from 12% to 3% in synthetic replay tests.

2026-03-10: First end-to-end shadow run against golden baselines completed for 6/12 models. Observed a 4% p95 improvement for kernel-route change on small-seq GPT-like family and a 7% memory regression on one variant (investigating kernel tiling issue).

2026-03-08 (Product - Lina K.): Add customer-impact classification per model in the matrix so PMs can prioritize triage for public-facing models.
